name: nyyon-command-center
description: An AI command center you own: outreach, writing and publishing from one place, in your voice.

scripts.seed:demo: node scripts/seed-app.mjs --demo-only > /tmp/nyyon-demo.sql && cd workers/api && npx wrangler d1 execute nyyon --local --file /tmp/nyyon-demo.sql
scripts.seed:clear-demo: node scripts/seed-app.mjs --clear-demo > /tmp/nyyon-clear.sql && cd workers/api && npx wrangler d1 execute nyyon --local --file /tmp/nyyon-clear.sql
